_notes_space_jobs: Space jobs, phase 1 (docs/space-jobs-contract.md; design page docs/mockups/space-jobs): side jobs of the pool chain space_jobs (rules.json "pool": true), offered to every chain's players in a game with a star system, from the sites their long-range scans have found (a space_site trigger binds the site; a colony ship is offered only sites within maps space_sites colony_reach_seconds of its colony's body). At most rules.max_side_active side jobs at once (counted with the chain's own); an offer lapses after offer_seconds. A pool job fails when the ship is crippled or its away team is called back; failing costs only the reward (hull damage and crew lost stay). Rewards: a ship that never lands gets grants into its stock and research where observation research goes; a colony ship as its colony's missions. Phase 2 (asteroids, mining, selling, towing): pay_dirt (mine two containers of ore and sell 60), ice_run (60 deuterium from an ice asteroid, sold or dropped), tow_job (take a derelict, worked out or not, in tow and deliver it); declined or lapsed offers come back after the pool chain's return_seconds. All numbers are placeholders.

missions.title: The Quiet Hulk
missions.briefing: Long-range contact: {hulk}, a hull with no power and no transponder. Nobody has filed a flight plan for it. Go and look.

objectives.text: Fly within range of {hulk} and scan it
objectives.hint: Set course for the contact, then SCAN from within range.
Hold position at the hulk and COME ALONGSIDE (20 s). Loose debris may strike the hull.

objectives.text: Board {hulk} with an away team and bring them back
objectives.hint: AWAY TEAM: pick 2 to 6. Defense lowers the loss chance; a Science medic turns losses into injuries. Leaving fails the job.

missions.debrief: Whatever built it, it wasn't anyone we know. Reyes wants everything the team saw written down tonight.

missions.title: Dead in the Water
missions.briefing: A dark ship on the long-range scan: {wreck}. Somebody owns it and somebody may still be aboard. Get power on, read the logs, search her.

objectives.hint: Her reactor is failing: a timer starts once you are alongside. Be gone before it blows.
60 s of Engineering work, or a hull patch kit at once.
Send an away team. Survivors who come aboard can join our crew.

missions.debrief: Her owners will want to know what happened. The logs tell most of it.

missions.title: What Happened Here
missions.briefing: A debris cloud at {field}: a ship broke up there, and not long ago. Sweep it, and find the black box.

objectives.hint: SWEEP THE FIELD. The hull wears while you are inside; the tractor must work and the hold needs room.

missions.debrief: The recorder's damaged, but there's enough on it to start asking who did this.

missions.title: Pay Dirt
missions.briefing: There's ore in {rock}, Okafor says, and the station pays latinum for it. Cut two containers out of it and sell them.

objectives.hint: Hold at the asteroid and MINE (a container every 30 s; the tractor must work). Rock falls scuff the hull; the hold needs room.
SELL in the ship status hold at the station, or to a freighter or tanker in orbit with you (it pays less).

missions.debrief: Honest work. Okafor wants a cutting rig on the next ship out.

missions.title: Ice Run
missions.briefing: {ice} is mostly water ice. Cracked aboard it is deuterium, and everyone needs deuterium. Bring 60 to someone who'll take it.

objectives.hint: MINE at the ice asteroid: each container is 30 deuterium.
Sell it at the station or to a tanker in orbit with you; a colony ship can DROP it down to the colony.

missions.debrief: Fuel in the tanks and latinum in the account. Moreau calls that a good day.

missions.title: Tow Job
missions.briefing: {hulk} is salvage, and salvage is money. Take her in tow and bring her in: the station pays for the metal, a colony can break her up.

objectives.hint: Hold at the wreck, COME ALONGSIDE, then TAKE IN TOW. The tractor must work; flights are slower while towing.

objectives.text: Deliver {hulk} to the station or the colony
objectives.hint: Fly to the station (or a colony ship's colony body) and DROP the tow from the hold.

missions.debrief: Okafor's already pricing the plating. Nice flying with a hulk on the line.
